title: Delegated billing ownership
intent: Let enterprise accounts delegate billing to another account while keeping ownership and eligibility responsibilities explicit.

groups.title: Account ownership
groups.summary: Account management exposes who owns the account and which account pays. Billing policy stays at the billing boundary.

groups.title: Client compatibility
groups.summary: Existing clients keep their current ownership contract while delegated ownership is introduced explicitly.

components.name: Client applications
components.current: Send the account owner as the payer.
components.intended: May provide a separate billing owner while keeping existing requests valid.
components.observed: Demo only: implementation has not been inspected.

components.name: Account management
components.current: Own account identity and a single owner reference.
components.intended: Own account identity and delegation. Expose ownership facts to billing.
components.observed: Demo only: implementation has not been inspected.

components.name: Billing service
components.current: Evaluate eligibility for the account owner.
components.intended: Evaluate eligibility for the delegated billing owner.
components.observed: Demo only: implementation has not been inspected.

decisions.title: Who owns eligibility policy?
decisions.choice: Billing owns eligibility; account management supplies ownership facts.
alternatives: A separate policy service owns eligibility.
consequences: Billing is the single policy owner.
The delegation contract crosses service boundaries.

decisions.title: How do existing clients migrate?
decisions.choice: Preserve the owner field and add an optional billing owner.
alternatives: Require all clients to migrate to a new contract.
consequences: Old clients continue using the account owner for billing.

acceptanceCriteria: Delegation does not move billing policy into account management.
unknowns: This is an illustrative demo, not a verified implementation.
